title: GDD T-104b — StagePresenter 3D: logical→world projection, StageProfiles (4 camera rigs), base prefab set (§10.4)
description: Framework (Unity) layer generalizing the Esquiva-3D scene approach per GDD §10.4. StagePresenter consumes Core RenderState (entities in logical [0,1]² + Height + EntityKind + OwnerSeat + VisualVariant, Annex D.2) and projects it into the 3D URP world according to the active StageProfile (data): camera rig topDownOrtho | frontFixed | runnerLateral | boardOverview; logical-plane-to-world mapping; EntityKind+VisualVariant -> low-poly prefab set with pooled instances and headless-safe primitive fallback (same pattern as DodgeGameBootstrap). Camera is placed at MG_INTRO and stays fixed during MG_PLAY (feedback shake <= 300 ms only; runnerLateral is the single travelling exception). Avatars get player-color tint (Rojo #E5484D, Azul #3B82F6, Amarillo #FACC15, Verde #22C55E) plus the redundant shape marker overhead (circle/square/triangle/rhombus, §8.1). Render interpolates between the two most recent sim states (§10.3 double buffer). Respect §14 budgets (unlit/simple-lit, no per-frame allocs). Read GDD §10.3/§10.4, §8.1, §14 and Annex D.1 (Esquiva-3D row) before coding. Unity Editor/MCP required for compile gate and scene verification — coordinate with orchestrator.
acceptance_criteria: StageProfile is data (camera type, plane mapping, prefab-set id) selectable per microgame definition; all 4 camera rigs implemented and placed at MG_INTRO
RenderState entities are projected every frame with interpolation between the two last sim states; steady-state rendering performs no per-frame heap allocations (pooled instances)
Camera never moves during MG_PLAY except feedback shake (<= 300 ms) — runnerLateral travelling is the only exception
Player avatars carry both channels: per-seat color tint AND the overhead shape marker (circle/square/triangle/rhombus)
Projection math (logical x,y,height -> world position per profile) is covered by fast or EditMode tests as regression locks
Headless-safe primitive fallback when a prefab is missing, mirroring the DodgeGameBootstrap pattern; compile gate clean in the Unity Editor

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body: Render-contract dependency SETTLED (TASK-048 closed 2026-07-07): RenderEntity.VisualVariant is now documented as the GDD 10.4 discrete prefab/skin selector (EntityKind+VisualVariant -> prefab, small cardinality, no scalar packing); continuous per-entity presentation values ride the new additive RenderEntity.Progress01 (float [0,1], mechanic-defined, presentation-only, defaults 0). Apunta publishes aim-interp progress there; HudState.Meters carries the per-seat charge meter. The presenter must consume BOTH channels. CARRY-IN NIT from rev-t048 (LOW, one word): RenderEntity.cs:30's doc comment cites 'Annex D.1's worked example' for stageProfile.entityPrefabSet — the worked example actually lives in GDD 11.1 (Annex D.1 only references StageProfile generally). Fix the citation on the first touch of RenderEntity.cs during this ticket.

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body: DESIGN CONTRACT RATIFIED by human (AskUserQuestion 2026-07-08) — resolves the 6 GDD gaps the research pass surfaced. Build to THIS: (1) CAMERA PROJECTION per rig: topDownOrtho=orthographic cenital (spec 10.4, ESQUIVA/PERSIGUE); frontFixed=LOW PERSPECTIVE, narrow FOV (RULED — APUNTA/REACCIONA; NOT ortho, honors 1.3 'escena 3D real'); runnerLateral=perspective baja (spec 10.4, CORRE); boardOverview=angled perspective framing all 20 ring cells [ASSUMED]. All 4 placed at MG_INTRO, fixed during MG_PLAY except shake<=300ms (runnerLateral travelling is the sole exception). (2) PLANE MAPPING = new explicit stageProfile.planeMapping object { worldSize:[w,d] world units, worldOrigin:[x,y,z] = plane center }; axis convention FIXED IN CODE: logicalX->worldX, logicalY->worldZ, Height->worldY(up) — mirrors DodgeGameBootstrap centered-XZ. This EXTENDS the 11.1 schema (which named the mapping in prose but omitted the field) + MicrogameDefinitionV2/Json/Migrator StageProfile. (3) SHAPE<->SEAT = canonical seat-order, fixed everywhere: P1=circulo, P2=cuadrado, P3=triangulo, P4=rombo (mirrors color<->seat P1 Rojo#E5484D / P2 Azul#3B82F6 / P3 Amarillo#FACC15 / P4 Verde#22C55E; 8.1). Avatars carry BOTH channels. (4) EntityKind = closed 6-member enum (PlayerAvatar/Hazard/Projectile/Target/BoardPawn/Pickup) — the D.2 '...' is illustrative; prefab-set maps exactly those 6. (5) runnerLateral + boardOverview built to documented [ASSUMED] defaults (no Hito-1 microgame validates them; revisit Hito 2 / Hito 4). Presenter consumes VisualVariant (discrete selector) AND Progress01 (float) AND HudState.Meters per the TASK-048 note above. Maximize headless-testable PURE projection math for AC5 regression locks (fast/EditMode). Research workflow wf_7ecc837f-256 FAILED (StructuredOutput retry-cap); design grounded by direct GDD read instead.

comments.body: GREEN HEADLESS REVIEW. dev-t027 delivered (8a71309 schema / 6467d13 Barcade.Presentation math / 8f6a8d1 Framework StagePresenter); fast suite 725/725; new UnityEngine-free Barcade.Presentation asmdef (Core-only) carries the projection/interp/rig math wired into the fast suite. rev-t027 (fresh context) = APPROVE-WITH-NITS, NO HIGH / NO MEDIUM, all 6 ACs met: AC5 tests independently confirmed non-vacuous (reviewer hand-derived sign-flip/axis-swap/dropped-origin/transposed-size cases); AC2 zero-alloc steady-state statically audited on Present() path (no new/LINQ/boxing; material caches once); AC4 seat->shape canonical (P1 Circle..P4 Rhombus) + GDD hex, no off-by-one (keyed on PlayerSlot enum); carry-in RenderEntity.cs:30 nit FIXED (->§11.1); ShapeFactory additive (Esquiva unaffected); planeMapping backward-compat locked. 4 LOW nits (non-blocking, deferred): (1) StagePrimitiveFactory.cs:24,53 comment overstates BoardPawn retint (only PlayerAvatar retinted — correct/AC4 is PlayerAvatar-only) — CHEAPEST, comment-only; (2) StagePresenter markers destroyed+recreated per Bind not reused (self-heals, per-round); (3) slot-index identity change => 1-frame lerp pop (inherent to slot pooling); (4) shake can chain across consecutive High ticks (>3/min cap is a test-level audit per §8.2, not StagePresenter's job).
